judgments.evidence:
constraints: user_name declares [type=text required]
  field value: user_name: '12345' -> 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA…[+1988 chars]'
  url        : /user/login?redirect_to=%2fuser%2fsign_up (unchanged)

judgments.observed: BROWSING_FORWARD from /user/login?redirect_to=%2fuser%2fsign_up navigated to /assets/licenses.txt, changing the title and page text.
judgments.expected: Forwarding should restore the previous state of the page.
judgments.discrepancy: Navigating forward did not return to the login page but instead went to an unexpected location (/assets/licenses.txt).
judgments.evidence:
url        : /user/login?redirect_to=%2fuser%2fsign_up -> /assets/licenses.txt
  title      : 'Sign In - Gitea: Git with a cup of tea' -> ''
  page text  : -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- @braintree/sanitize-url@6.0.4 - MIT -------------------------------------------

judgments.observed: Navigating back to /user/login?redirect_to=%2fuser%2fsign_up reset the form state, hiding controls and links.
judgments.expected: Going back should restore the previous page's state including form values and visible elements.
judgments.discrepancy: The form fields were cleared and some UI elements hidden upon navigation back, which is unexpected behavior.
